Yes, I accept it. This is what I set out to build: one dependable place where I can paste a link and have it collect the details, keep me from piling up duplicates, let me open my saved links, search through them without fussing over capitalization, and organize them with labels I can click to narrow things down — plus that Undo safety net when I remove something by mistake. Everything we settled together is here, and you've confirmed it all holds up. I'm happy to call this the finished first version.

I do have a few ideas I'd like to explore down the road — things like marking links to read later and tidying old ones away — but those are for another time, not anything to hold this up. Thank you; this solves the mess I came in with.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
